pages.text: $(o)A crab the size of a cart, armored in living crystal. It keeps the $(l)Amethyst Nest$() deep in the lush caves of the Hearthlands.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It mends faster the healthier it is. Hit hard from the first second and never let up; a slow party never finishes it.$(br2)Light the cave before you wake it.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Geode Claw$() raises your world tier to Venture.
